title: Acme / CRM feed integration
context: Acme + CRM dealer-feed integration: imports dealers and inventory from third-party feeds into api-core via worker-sync. End-to-end flow: feed CSV -> worker import (AcmeImportDealers) -> ProcessFeedQueueJob -> api-core DealerService -> dealer + inventory rows. Subscription-type correctness is the live concern (see hotfix task).
